name: Vivanta Aurangabad
why_special: Taj-IHCL's 4-star Vivanta near Bibi Ka Maqbara — 113 rooms, outdoor pool, Latitude all-day diner and Mynt for fine dining. The Aurangabad city hotel with the strongest Taj-group service and the easiest morning departure for the Ajanta/Ellora circuit.

name: WelcomHotel by ITC Rama International
why_special: ITC's WelcomHotel Rama International on Jalna Road — 134 rooms across landscaped grounds 3 km from Chikalthana airport, outdoor pool, the Pavilion all-day buffet, and the longest-running 5-star service brand in Aurangabad city.

name: Lemon Tree Premier Aurangabad
why_special: Lemon Tree Premier-tier with citrus-design rooms 4 km from Aurangabad airport — pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the most consistent mid-range brand service at 30–40% less than ITC Rama. The cleanest Ajanta/Ellora day-trip base on a budget.

name: The Meadows Hotel & Resort
why_special: 37-cottage resort across landscaped grounds on Mitmita Road, 5 km from Aurangabad railway and 8 km from Bibi-Ka-Maqbara — outdoor pool, on-site Maharashtrian restaurant, on-call taxi for the Ajanta-Ellora-Daulatabad triangle. The cottage-format pick when you want garden-grounds over a city block.
